text:
The defendant who sees an armed man waiting outside and deliberately does not warn her husband is most likely guilty of murder. A spouse has a legal duty to protect the other, and choosing silence because she wants him dead, knowing he will be shot, is an omission with intent to kill. Lending a car to an intoxicated friend who then causes a fatal crash lacks malice aforethought and is at most involuntary manslaughter.

CONFIDENCE: 86
